name: codex-workspace-enhancer
description: A native, port-free Codex visual workspace for arranging project images, references, and creative notes on an infinite canvas.

interface.shortDescription: Arrange project images on a native infinite canvas.
interface.longDescription: Visual Workspace opens inside Codex as a native image canvas with inline, fullscreen, and PiP negotiation. Read approved project images without a localhost service, arrange references and generated work spatially, add notes, and optionally use the macOS right-side workspace panel without auto-sending a message.
defaultPrompt: Open the native visual workspace for this project.
Open my project images on the visual canvas.
Read the images selected in Visual Workspace and help me iterate on them.
